title: check-init
summary: Answers whether a variable or field is set before a given use on every execution (SET / NEVER-SET / MAY-BE-UNSET)
intro: Ask it before adding an Assigned guard or reordering initialization: it names the writers of a unit variable, class var or field and says whether one of them runs before the use on every path, with the reason code and the witness when it cannot prove it. Exit 0 = all SET, 1 = some MAY-BE-UNSET or NEVER-SET, 2 = error.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Analyze > Check Initialization of Identifier at Cursor...
steps: Put the caret on a unit variable, class var or field in the editor
Choose drag-lint > Analyze > Check Initialization of Identifier at Cursor...
Read the verdict, the writers and the reason for each use

questions.ask: Is this variable set before it is read here, on every execution?
Which routines or events set this field?
